license_required.quote: Except as provided in 37-69-102, a person working at the field of plumbing in this state, either as a master plumber or as a journeyman plumber, shall first obtain a license as provided in Title 37, chapter 69, part 3.

degree_required.value: No formal degree required; experience-based with credit allowed for accredited trade school training

experience_source.quote: a specific record of 5 years of legally obtained experience in the field of plumbing. This experience requirement may be fulfilled by: (i) working 5 years in a major phase of the plumbing business, verified by time or pay records; or (ii) completing an apprenticeship program meeting the standards set by the department or the United States department of labor, bureau of apprenticeship.

duration.value: 5 years for journeyman; 4 years as licensed journeyman plus 3 years supervisory experience for master

exams.name: Journeyman Plumber Examination
exams.notes: Written examination and, if required by the board, a practical demonstration.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by department, content prescribed by board)
exams.quote: satisfactory completion of a written examination prescribed by the board and conducted by the department, subject to 37-1-101(4), testing the applicant's knowledge of techniques and methods employed in the field of plumbing and, if required by the board, a practical demonstration establishing competence in the special skills required in the field of plumbing.

exams.name: Master Plumber Examination
exams.notes: Examination prescribed by the board for master plumbers testing knowledge, skill, and ability.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by department, content prescribed by board)
exams.quote: satisfactory completion of an examination prescribed by the board for master plumbers testing the applicant's knowledge of the field of plumbing and demonstrating skill and ability in the field of plumbing.

available.quote: Except as provided in Title 37, chapter 39, the board shall issue a license to practice without examination to a person licensed in another state if the board determines that: (a) the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state; and (b) there is no reason to deny the license under the laws of this state governing the profession or occupation.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state with substantially equivalent or greater standards, affirm verification request from other state, and not be subject to pending charges or final disciplinary action.
requirements.quote: the board shall issue a license to practice without examination to a person licensed in another state if the board determines that: (a) the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state; and (b) there is no reason to deny the license under the laws of this state governing the profession or occupation.

credential_type.quote: The applicant must, on successfully passing an examination prescribed by the board, be issued a license authorizing the applicant to engage in the field of plumbing as a master plumber or journeyman plumber in the state of Montana.

title_protection.quote: "Master plumber" means a person who is authorized by this chapter to plan, estimate, bid, contract for, and supervise plumbing work

scope_protection.quote: a person who engages in the field of plumbing at a time when the person is not licensed is subject to the penalties imposed by this chapter.
